q1_issues.issue: The genitive 'the water of the Sunken Cove' is encoded as (LocatedIn $wt $sc), but an of-genitive is routed through PartOf (part/component) or the opaque Possession, and LocatedIn is reserved for the containment prepositions in/at/inside/within — so the query conjunct will not match a faithful statement parse of the same phrase.

q2_gaps: an ordinal day-of-year date in a non-Gregorian calendar ('day 120 of Year 1'): the Time terms (Day <n>) / (Year <n>) are specified for a calendar day (with a month) and a year, and nothing addresses a bare day-number with no month, which (Day 120) silently borrows the month-day slot for
notes: Agent for the self-propelled animate 'a wraith emerged', Source for 'from the water', the Name binding for 'the Sunken Cove' and the Past + ReasonFor conjuncts are all right; the extra (Member $sc cove) beside (Name $sc "Sunken Cove") is redundant but matchable, since the kind word inside the name licenses that atom statement-side.
